lines: A custom ride is yours alone, so it stops whenever you do: pause, lose the bike, leave or end.
Pause holds the clock, the plan and the readouts at six fifty-two. The resistance stays in your hands, and Resume carries on from there.
If the bike stops answering, the ride pauses on its own and says so. Reconnect, and it waits for you to press Resume.
Open the ride with no bike, and it waits at zero behind Connect your bike. With Bluetooth off, it asks you to turn it on first.
Library pauses the ride and asks: save it and open the library, discard it, or keep riding. Escape keeps riding.
End saves the ride and opens Profile, and so does the plan's end. A ride under a minute is not kept, and Profile says so.
Leave this ride, from a phone to the full screen.
Telo Ride, from the Telo family, turns a smart bike at home into a game.
It pairs with the bike over Bluetooth, reads your power and sets resistance for every hill and interval.

lines.text: Two doors: Race, ride a map against your best-time ghost, bots or people; and Classes, ride along to a video, alone or with a group; fed by one progression of XP, rider levels, stars and map unlocks.
